newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 21 and 23 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on August 7, the Treasury said on Tuesday.

The Treasury will offer the current 10-year benchmark OAT, the 5.50 percent October 25, 2007 bond. It also said it would offer the 6.50 percent April 25, 2011 OAT and the 6.0 percent October 25, 2025 OAT.
Traders had said earlier they expected either the 2011 or the 2025 OAT to be sold in addition to the 10-year OAT.
The Treasury will also be selling 300 to 500 million Ecus of the 5.5 percent April 2007 OAT at the same time.
All four bonds will have a payment date of August 14, the statement said.
The Treasury stopped selling Ecu OATs and BTANs at separate auctions from July and now offers them at the same time as the regular French franc OAT and BTAN auctions.
